query_original: 휴머노이드 로봇 상용화 기술: 휴머노이드(이족보행·인간형) 로봇의 상용화에 직접 쓰이거나 이전 가능한 핵심 기술 — 전신·보행·균형 제어, 로봇손·파지·촉각, 다관절 매니퓰레이션 학습·제어, 관절 액추에이터·감속기(QDD·SEA), 로봇 비전·VLA·모방학습, 텔레오퍼레이션·Sim-to-Real, 인간협업 안전. 특정 공정 전용 산업설비, 수술로봇, 착용형 외골격, 청소기, 물류 반송 전용, 완구는 제외.

scope.disambiguation_notes: The query focuses on technologies directly applicable or transferable to the commercialization of humanoid robots, specifically those with bipedal locomotion and human-like features. It excludes technologies for specific industrial processes, surgical robots, wearable exoskeletons, cleaning robots, logistics transport, and toys.
initial_task_hypotheses: The technology must enable full-body control and balance in humanoid robots.
The technology must facilitate advanced manipulation capabilities, including robotic hands and tactile sensing.
The technology must involve learning and control of multi-joint manipulation.
The technology must include joint actuators and reducers, such as QDD and SEA.
The technology must support robot vision, VLA, and imitation learning.
The technology must ensure safe human-robot collaboration.
